title: Delhi High Court Quashes 2018 SFIO Probe Order Against Educomp Solutions for Want of Reasons
case_name: Vinod Kumar Dandona v. Union of India & Ors. (with connected petition, Ashish Mittal v. Union of India & Ors.)
card_summary: Justice Amit Mahajan quashed the 2018 government order directing an SFIO probe into Educomp Solutions, holding it was passed mechanically and without reasons. An earlier inspection report had already found the fraud and fund-diversion allegations unfounded. The ruling, on petitions by former director Vinod Kumar Dandona and former CFO Ashish Mittal, also disposes of the SFIO's 2022 criminal complaint.
card_tip: A Section 212(1)(c) order directing an SFIO probe must show the government applied its mind to the record; one that ignores a prior report already clearing the same allegations will not survive review.
verification_notes: Decision date (16 October 2026), judge, and the quashing of the 2018 MCA order are consistent across Bar and Bench, LiveLaw, LiveLawBiz and LawChakra. Case numbers for the Dandona and Mittal petitions are as reported by LiveLaw; one source (LawChakra) names only the Mittal petition as the lead matter, so the case caption here follows the fuller Bar and Bench/LiveLaw reporting.
